source_summary: Tall vertical Chinese landscape with layered ink-and-color mountains, misty ravines, pine and bamboo groves, architectural pavilions, village courtyards, scholar figures, a bridge, and foreground rocks and trees. Calligraphy, seals, margins, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_towering_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain mass: a high rounded cliff with layered vertical rock folds, dark ink contour strokes, pale mineral-green and ochre washes, clusters of pines and shrubs growing from ledges, and soft mist fading around the lower right edge. Exclude nearby buildings and separate lower village areas.
must_preserve: dark ridge outlines and crevice lines
small white mineral highlights on ledges
pine clusters and shrub dots embedded in the cliffs

motifs.name: left_pine_mountain_pass
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side mountain pass with sweeping pale slopes and a cluster of tall pines leaning across the ravine. Include the narrow trunks, horizontal pine boughs, needle clusters, and the curved washed hillside behind them.
must_preserve: pale sloping wash behind the trees
soft mist boundary at the ravine

motifs.name: right_misty_peak_group
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side distant and middle-distance peaks emerging from mist: narrow blue-green spires, pale cliff faces, darker textured rocky ridges, and low fog pooling between them. Exclude the central mountain and foreground bridge area.
must_preserve: thin ink outlines on ridge tops
vertical rock texture on nearer crags
small white highlight flecks on rock ledges

motifs.name: mid_left_village_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-left grove and hidden village cluster on a slope: mixed deciduous trees, pale trunks, clustered small roofs or walls partly concealed by foliage, and the sloping terrain leading upward. Exclude the larger lower courtyards.
must_preserve: small pale architectural hints behind trees
subtle red and green color accents
overlapping tree trunks at different depths

motifs.name: bamboo_scholar_clearing
motifs.description: Isolate the bamboo grove clearing in the middle right with scholars and attendants around a table. Include the dense vertical bamboo stems, dark leafy canopy, open pale ground, small seated and standing figures, and the simple table setting.
must_preserve: tiny figure robes with muted color accents

motifs.name: lower_left_courtyard_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left residential compound with connected pavilions, tiled roofs, veranda posts, interior seated figures, surrounding garden trees, rocks, and banana-like leaves. Avoid including the calligraphy along the far left edge.
must_preserve: tree trunks crossing in front of buildings
green foliage and broad leaf color accents

motifs.name: waterside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the small open pavilion beside water in the lower middle-right: raised platform on posts, hip roof, railings, two small figures, scattered rocks, and the pale water or bank around it. Exclude the nearby arched bridge.
must_preserve: vertical support posts reflected against pale ground
light wash indicating water or open bank

motifs.name: arched_bridge_crossing
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right arched bridge scene with scholar figures crossing near trees and rocks. Include the rounded bridge arch, railing strokes, stream wash below, flanking trees, figures in muted robes, and rocky banks.
must_preserve: small figures with red and pale robe accents

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
